video-1b.title: 02. Distributed Systems Architecture & Enterprise Scale
video-1b.description: SOLID principles, layer decoupling, and clean data management.

video-1c.title: 03. Advanced PostgreSQL Modeling with Prisma ORM & Indexes

video-2a.title: 04. Robust Security: JWT Auth, RBAC & VIP Bypass
video-2a.description: Admin, VIP, and External roles implementation with Express route guards.

video-2b.title: 05. Cloud Deployment & Performance Optimization
video-2b.description: Video streaming from Google Drive and production bundling.
